item.title: TTT 332: Knock Knock
item.description: The Dutch sure have a strange way to celebrate Christmas. It involves dressing up in blackface and acting like idiots. Maybe it’s a cultural thing that is lost to North Americans. Also, we got an email from a Houston hip hop artist because we “have an impact in the music industry”. Really? I thought we just talked a lot a shit and played shitty Eurovision songs. We’ll take any praise we can get.
